title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner Location : Remote

Contract : PJ (full-time)

Level : Senior

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio / video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands‑on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end‑to‑end (discovery → definition → delivery → post‑launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English) : Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow‑through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership : Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non‑negotiable) : Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links). Create extremely well‑documented tickets : clear problem statement, context, scope / out‑of‑scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non‑functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition : User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing : Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement : Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research : Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer :

What was completed today.

The current task and ETA for completion.

The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.

Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).

Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).

Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.

Maintain AI‑generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).

Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must‑Haves

5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.

Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.

Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.

Proven follow‑through : nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.

Nice to Have

Exposure to WebRTC / A / V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.

Tooling (required)

  • Jira
  • Confluence
  • Figma
  • Slack
  • Google Sheets

Certifications

CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade, manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX, assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.

  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras e indicadores operacionais.

Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência.
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.

KPIs da função

  • Pontualidade dos envios obrigatórios (100% dentro do prazo D+0/D+1).
  • Acurácia dos arquivos/posições (≥ 99,9%).
  • Reconciliações concluídas diariamente (100% D+1 sem pendências críticas).
  • Zero falhas não tratadas em APIX/CCS (0 incidentes críticos por mês).
  • SLA de resposta a áreas internas/BCB/auditores (≤ 1 dia útil).

Modelo de trabalho

Local: Remoto. Regime: PJ. Disponibilidade para janela operacional de envios/concilições no início do dia.

title: Tech lead
description:
Sobre a CLI Nós somos a CLI Consultoria, especialistas em integração de sistemas e gestão fiscal/tributária, com foco em simplificar processos complexos e gerar valor real para os negócios.

Nosso propósito é claro: descomplicar a vida das pessoas e empresas por meio da tecnologia. Atuamos em parceria com grandes players de mercado, como MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato e Thomson Reuters, conduzindo projetos desafiadores de transformação digital em empresas de grande porte.

O que realmente nos move não são apenas os sistemas que construímos, mas as pessoas por trás deles. Acreditamos que cada conexão, seja entre dados, sistemas ou talentos, é capaz de gerar impacto real.

Na CLI, Valorizamos

  • Inovação trazer soluções criativas para problemas complexos.
  • Aprendizado contínuo crescer junto, como time e como indivíduos.
  • Confiança e colaboração atuar de forma transparente, aberta e parceira.
  • Autonomia com responsabilidade liberdade para criar, com foco em resultados.

Somos uma empresa 100% remota, e isso nos permite unir talentos de diferentes lugares com um mesmo propósito: entregar excelência, sempre com o cliente no centro de cada decisão.

Estamos em constante evolução e crescimento, e isso só é possível porque acreditamos no poder das pessoas. Procuramos quem tenha brilho nos olhos, quem enxergue oportunidades onde há desafios e quem curta a energia de transformar, simplificar e inovar junto com a gente.

Se você busca um lugar para colocar suas ideias em prática, se desenvolver e fazer parte de algo maior, a CLI pode ser o seu próximo passo.

Bora crescer com a gente? #VemSerCLI

O desafio da posição

Como Líder Técnico(a) de Tecnologia, você será o elo estratégico entre clientes, liderança, times técnicos e áreas de negócio, conduzindo a arquitetura, operação e governança das soluções tecnológicas e de dados que sustentam a tomada de decisão e a inovação da empresa.

Seu papel é garantir a excelência técnica, a estabilidade operacional e a evolução contínua das soluções, conectando visão técnica e estratégica para assegurar que os ambientes e integrações de dados sejam escaláveis, seguros, íntegros e aderentes à estratégia da organização.

Atuará de forma prática e orientada a resultados, supervisionando implementações, guiando decisões de arquitetura, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança, qualidade e governança, assegurando que as entregas gerem valor real para os clientes e para o negócio.

Além da excelência técnica, sua atuação será essencial na liderança e desenvolvimento do time, fomentando uma cultura de confiança, aprendizado contínuo, colaboração e melhoria constante. Você apoiará a evolução individual e coletiva dos profissionais, conduzindo ciclos de desempenho, acompanhando PDIs, promovendo feedbacks construtivos e garantindo um ambiente saudável e produtivo.

Seu desafio é equilibrar visão estratégica e execução técnica, impulsionando a performance das plataformas e fortalecendo tanto a base tecnológica quanto a cultura humana da empresa, promovendo crescimento sustentável, inovação e resultados consistentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir, revisar e garantir a aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e governança de dados.
  • Apoiar o time comercial e de arquitetura em atuações com o cliente, como por exemplo, kickoff ou agendas para falar sobre questões mais técnicas.
  • Conduzir decisões estratégicas sobre soluções, integrações e infraestrutura, alinhando tecnologia e negócio.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento dos casos envolvendo o time que está sendo supervisionado, garantindo que não tenham demandas paradas, tirando empecilhos e apoiando.
  • Monitorar continuamente a performance, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções, garantindo eficiência e cumprimento de SLAs.
  • Antecipar riscos técnicos, propor soluções preventivas e conduzir revisões pós-incidente, assegurando estabilidade e escalabilidade dos ambientes.
  • Validar soluções técnicas propostas pelo time, garantindo qualidade, rastreabilidade, segurança e aderência a padrões de engenharia.
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de incidentes críticos, orientando decisões e priorizações de forma assertiva.
  • Garantir documentação técnica padronizada, atualizada e rastreável, assegurando transparência e histórico das implementações.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida das demandas (requisições, incidentes e melhorias), assegurando prazos, qualidade e satisfação do cliente interno e externo.
  • Monitorar indicadores técnicos e operacionais (tempo de resposta, performance, estabilidade, NPS técnico) e propor planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e de comportamento, inspirando confiança, autonomia e senso de dono no time.
  • Promover revisões técnicas e análises pós-mortem, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico e suporte diário aos integrantes da equipe, garantindo alinhamento e desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Conduzir feedbacks, 1:1s e planos de desenvolvimento individual (PDIs e PDAs), acompanhando evolução e desempenho dos profissionais.
  • Identificar necessidades de capacitação técnica, propor trilhas de aprendizado e fomentar o crescimento técnico da equipe.
  • Apoiar decisões de gestão de pessoas, incluindo contratações, promoções, férias e movimentações, em parceria com o time de Pessoas e Cultura.
  • Promover um ambiente de colaboração, transparência e aprendizado constante, fortalecendo a cultura técnica e os pilares organizacionais.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, compliance e governança de dados, mantendo integridade e confiabilidade das soluções.
  • Conduzir revisões técnicas periódicas e propor otimizações em código, processos e arquitetura, com foco em eficiência e inovação.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de qualidade, melhoria contínua e inovação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento e operação.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura e integração e automação entre plataformas.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência em liderança técnica ou coordenação de times de tecnologia; Conhecimento em práticas de versionamento (Git), ambiente de teste/homologação, boas práticas de segurança, documentação técnica e observabilidade.
  • Experiência com plataformas de integração, como Mulesoft, Boomi ou Pentaho.
  • Diferencial:
    • Experiência com governança de dados.
    • Experiência com pipelines de dados, mensageria e automações.
    • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados.
    • Certificações em MuleSoft, Boomi ou Pentaho.
    • Atuação anterior em ambientes de consultoria ou prestação de serviços técnicos.
    • Vivência com SRE/DevOps.

Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Escuta ativa e empatia técnica: Compreender necessidades de clientes, colegas e áreas parceiras, traduzindo demandas de forma colaborativa e com foco em valor real nas entregas.
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva: Transmitir informações técnicas e estratégicas de forma objetiva, garantindo entendimento entre públicos diversos e promovendo alinhamento e confiança.
  • Proatividade e senso de dono: Antecipar riscos e necessidades, agir com autonomia e responsabilidade sobre resultados, assegurando continuidade e qualidade das soluções.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes: Manter rastreabilidade, precisão e qualidade nas execuções, controlando prazos, logs, SLAs e documentações técnicas de forma estruturada.
  • Visão sistêmica e estratégica: Compreender o impacto das decisões técnicas no negócio, conectando tecnologia, pessoas e resultados com coerência e responsabilidade.
  • Resiliência e equilíbrio: Manter serenidade e foco diante de crises ou pressões, conduzindo o time com segurança e postura construtiva.
  • Colaboração e liderança inspiradora: Atuar de forma integrada com diferentes áreas e perfis, promovendo um ambiente de confiança, reconhecimento e desenvolvimento mútuo.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua: Buscar inovação e aprendizado constante, aplicando novas ferramentas, práticas e lições aprendidas para evoluir processos, soluções e comportamentos.
  • Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: Ajustar-se a diferentes contextos e tecnologias com flexibilidade, aprendendo com as mudanças e contribuindo para o crescimento coletivo.
  • Postura ética e íntegra: Zelar por segurança, compliance e confidencialidade, agindo com coerência, justiça e transparência em todas as interações.

Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação / Vale Refeição (VA/VR)
  • Plano Médico

  • Incentivo à Certificação
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Day Off de Aniversário

Por que fazer parte da CLI?

Aqui você encontrará um ambiente que valoriza inovação, autonomia e colaboração. Trabalhamos em ritmo acelerado, mas sempre com foco em qualidade, aprendizado e impacto.

Se você é apaixonado por criar conexões entre tecnologia e pessoas, e acredita no poder de transformar negócios através da integração, seu lugar é com a gente!

description:
Join to apply for the Accounts Receivable Specialist role at Enghouse Systems

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Finance team. This role is responsible for the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing, efficient collections, and proper reconciliation of accounts. The ideal candidate will be experienced in managing client relationships, resolving billing discrepancies, and supporting month‑end close activities in a fast‑paced, international environment. This is a remote position open to candidates based in Brazil, reporting to the Accounts Receivable Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, issue, and record invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Manage collections, proactively following up with clients to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.
  • Record and apply customer payments in the financial/ERP system, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal policies.
  • Maintain and reconcile AR sub‑ledgers, intercompany accounts, and assigned balance sheet accounts.
  • Analyze and resolve account discrepancies by collaborating with sales, operations, and other internal teams.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Coordenador(a)/Lead de Design responsável por assegurar a qualidade técnica do produto digital e demonstrar, com evidências, o impacto do design nos resultados do negócio. Atuará de forma integrada aos times de Produto e Tecnologia, conduzindo a experiência de ponta a ponta — da concepção à entrega — com coerência entre jornadas, interfaces, estados e conteúdo, e registrando comparativos "antes/depois" que sustentem decisões executivas.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
About the Role

Ledn, a global financial services company focused on digital assets, is hiring an Information Technology Manager. The role will lead the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team, own end‑user support, manage endpoints, automate identity and access, and administer cloud‑based IT systems and tools.

Responsibilities

  • Provide first‑line triage and troubleshooting for Mac users via Slack, Jira, and other channels.
  • Procure, deliver, and retire technology equipment for all employees.
  • Own the onboarding experience for new hires and offboarding for departing staff.
  • Design, test, build, and document scripts, programs, policies, and tools that improve quality and efficiency.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, and Jira.
  • Administer Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta) and document solutions.
  • Write help articles and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Respond to, manage, and resolve critical incidents through to completion.
  • Prioritise help‑desk tickets and manage workload effectively.
  • Work on projects using agile methods and sprints, documenting progress in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objective and key results with minimal direction, aligning them to team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS system administration, including Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, and NetSuite.
  • Proficiency with Bash, Zsh, Python, and related scripting languages.
  • Experience with open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs.
  • Remote support experience across multiple time zones, shipping hardware, and customs handling.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.

description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote‑first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for an Account Executive to join our strategic sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and closing new business opportunities, building strategic relationships, and helping innovative companies unlock the full potential of Twilio’s communication platform. You will work closely with internal teams (Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, etc.) to understand client needs and deliver customized solutions that drive real business value. Responsibilities

  • Represent Twilio at industry events, conferences, and meetings to build pipeline and elevate brand awareness.
  • Champion the voice of the customer internally to help shape future product enhancements and go‑to‑market strategies.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in the SaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise software industries.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and driving multi‑million dollar deals.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to technical and business stakeholders at the enterprise level.
  • Strong consultative selling skills and ability to develop tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Comfortable navigating complex organizations and influencing cross‑functional teams (e.g., product, marketing, engineering).
  • Deep understanding of the sales cycle, including prospecting, qualifying, forecasting, and closing.

Location

Remote, based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in‑person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That’s why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

About the Team

Come join as a founding member of the LATAM Sales team at Miro! We are a collaborative, inclusive, and supportive group that enjoys working with our globally distributed teammates and partners. Our objective is to assemble the most impressive group of professionals to build an expansive ecosystem that delights our customers, partners, and developers. You’ll be one of the founding members of the LATAM Sales team with the mission of growing LATAM. As an Account Executive, you will focus on developing a new market for Miro, accelerating deal cycles and closing deals for net-new accounts in the enterprise space and expanding accounts by focusing on each line of business. You will join a highly motivated, energetic sales team that takes pride in landing new customers, running strategic sales cycles, and delivering the Miro value proposition to a wide base of accounts across various industries and drive expansion in our accounts by leveraging existing relationships in our installed base today. You will be skilled at using research to gain insight into customer challenges, identifying key stakeholders, and challenging customers’ thinking about how Miro can transform the way businesses work. Our goal is to create great customer experiences by being Miro product experts and consulting with customers to identify the needs and pain points.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect, develop, and close new customers on our Miro Platform

  • Identify, establish, and cultivate relationships with senior‑level executives
  • Forecast pipeline accurately and achieve monthly and quarterly quotas
  • Combine the interests of multiple client stakeholders to drive account revenue growth
  • Build account action plans to help define appropriate expansion strategies
  • Be a key component in ensuring we have accurate data in our CRM to drive the strategy for our future growth
  • Use a variety of methods (email, phone, social media) to engage prospects, users, and decision makers

What You’ll Need

  • 4+ years of selling and closing enterprise complex SaaS sales deals and exceeding quota

  • Spanish native speaker and English speaking
  • Strong prospecting, territory/account planning, and teamSelling experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • You are a results‑oriented individual who is excited by the prospect of fueling the continued growth and success of Miro by growing our sales pipeline. You have a “can‑do” attitude and are relentless in pursuing goals and solving problems.

What’s In It For You

  • Competitive equity package
  • Health insurance for you and your family
  • Wellbeing benefit and WFH equipment allowance
  • Annual learning and development allowance to grow your skills and career
  • Opportunity to work for a globally diverse team
  • Travel allowance for your commute

About Miro

Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform’s infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co‑headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100 M users and 250 k companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1 600 employees in 13 hubs around the world. We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!

Job description

ioasys é especialista em criar soluções únicas para empresas ousadas. Somos experts em trazer o melhor do universo digital para nossos clientes, transformando, repensando e evoluindo a sociedade. Nosso objetivo é ajudar marcas a inovar seguindo os princípios da metodologia ágil e abordagem centrada no usuário.

Para a vaga de Cientista de Dados , buscamos uma pessoa que seja apaixonada por descobrir oportunidades ocultas e capaz de levantar e priorizar as necessidades dos clientes de maneira eficaz. Este profissional será responsável por trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de negócio para identificar requisitos, definir estratégias de dados e implementar soluções que impulsionam a inovação e o crescimento.

Você estará em uma equipe horizontal e transparente, que não apenas valoriza suas ideias, mas também espera que você faça parte da construção da empresa com a gente.

Main responsibilities

  • Desenvolvimento e Otimização de Modelos de IA: Manter e evoluir modelos YOLOv8 para classificação de documentos, BERT para normalização de exames médicos e integração com GPT-4 para extração estruturada de dados;
  • Arquitetura Serverless: Desenvolver e otimizar Azure Functions em Python, implementando processamento assíncrono via Azure Service Bus com arquitetura event-driven;
  • Pipeline de OCR Inteligente: Aprimorar pipeline que combina Azure Cognitive Services OCR com pós-processamento via LLMs, incluindo detecção de checkboxes, processamento de manuscritos e formulários médicos;
  • Performance e Escalabilidade: Otimizar throughput do sistema, implementar batching inteligente, reduzir latência end-to-end;
  • Integração de Sistemas: Manter integrações com APIs externas (validação CRM, Sensedia), PostgreSQL, AWS S3, e implementar novos conectores conforme necessário.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência sólida com Python (3.9+) e desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conhecimento prático de Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Cognitive Services);
  • Experiência com modelos de ML em produção (preferencialmente visão computacional e/ou NLP);
  • Familiaridade com frameworks: PyTorch/TensorFlow, Transformers, Ultralytics (YOLO);
  • Experiência com processamento de documentos e OCR;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria assíncrona.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com fine-tuning de LLMs (GPT, BERT);
  • Conhecimento de algoritmos de string matching (Jaro-Winkler, Fuzzy Matching);
  • Experiência com processamento de imagens médicas ou documentos de saúde;
  • Familiaridade com observabilidade (OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor);
  • Experiência com otimização de inferência de modelos de ML.

Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada sobre os processos e integrações realizadas

Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Receivable : Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations : Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .

Month-End Workbooks : Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.

Financial Reporting : Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).

NetSuite : Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.

Communication and Task Management : Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.

Education : Accounting or Finance degree preferred.

Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.

Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.

Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.

US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.

Experience working with European entities is a plus.

Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Working Equipment to start is required.

Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.

1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.

Full access to TGG University and learning materials.

Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

About the Job

The QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. The QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.

The QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.

  • Plan and Manage Testing Activities: Oversee test planning, prioritization, and execution across projects. Ensure test coverage aligns with business impact, release timelines, and risk assessment.

  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.

  • Ensure Quality Governance and Standards: Define QA processes, templates, and best practices to standardize testing across teams. Maintain consistency in documentation, defect management, and reporting.

  • Collaborate with Cross‑Functional Teams: Work closely with product managers, developers, and DevOps to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC. Participate in planning and other ceremonies where applicable to provide support and guidance.

  • Oversee Test Automation Strategy: Guide the design, maintenance, and optimization of automation frameworks. Ensure automation coverage is effective, scalable, and well‑integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Manage Test Environments and Data: Coordinate environment setup, data preparation, and version control to ensure test consistency and reliability across manual and automated executions.

  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.

  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.

  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.

  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).

  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.

  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

  • Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification.

Important information for candidates

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Remote-first; worldwide applicants welcome. Compensation set based on agreed hours / work scope of part-time role (flexible).

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.

Who You Are / Qualifications

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat within 12 months through results.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Partner Recruitment & Support

    • Assist in the onboarding process for new partners, ensuring a smooth setup and integration experience.

  1. Monday: Join the weekly Partnerships team huddle; review and prioritize partner outreach and onboarding tasks.
  2. Tuesday: Research potential new partners for a client campaign and initiate strategic outreach with senior guidance.
  3. Wednesday: Assist in compiling a partner performance report for a client business review.
  4. Thursday: Join weekly client calls to discuss new partner opportunities and provide feedback.
  5. Friday: Attend an internal training session on a new partner platform integration; update the partner contact database and reflect on learnings for the week & review progress towards quarterly goals and report via Metronome.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing, affiliate marketing, partnerships, sales, or a related field (internships and entry-level experience welcome).

We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio / video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.

We’re seeking a hands‑on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end‑to‑end (discovery → definition → delivery → post‑launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.

What You’ll Do

  • Daily communication (English) : Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow‑through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership : Plan OKRs / roadmap; break initiatives into epics / stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non‑negotiable) : Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links). Create extremely well‑documented tickets : clear problem statement, context, scope / out‑of‑scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non‑functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs / screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready / Done and maintain Confluence specs / decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views / boards.
  • Discovery & definition : User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs / specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing : Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement : Track activation / engagement / retention, run A / B experiments, and prioritize UX / performance / stability improvements.
  • Competitor research : Benchmark features / flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.

Reporting & rituals

Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer :

What was completed today.

The current task and ETA for completion.

The next 3 tasks with planned start / end dates.

Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).

Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).

Mirror this view in Jira dashboards / filters with Stage / Prod target dates visible.

Maintain AI‑generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).

Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.

Must‑Haves

5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.

Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.

Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code / PRs at a high level.

Proven follow‑through : nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.

Nice to Have

Exposure to WebRTC / A / V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.

Tooling (required)

  • Jira
  • Confluence
  • Figma
  • Slack
  • Google Sheets

Certifications

CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

The Full Stack Developer for the Text Sentinel application will play a crucial role in maintaining, enhancing, and scaling the system's architecture and user interface. Front‑End Development

  • Build and maintain the UI using ReactJS, ensuring responsiveness, cross-browser compatibility, and a seamless user experience.
  • Integrate front-end components with back-end APIs and AWS services.

Testing and Debugging

  • Debug and resolve production issues to ensure system reliability.

Operations

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot data issues, including missing or inconsistent records, query failures, and performance degradation.
  • Ability to investigate data discrepancies across systems (e.g., source vs target, API vs DB) using joins, comparisons, and reconciliation techniques.
  • Experience with monitoring and alerting on data health (e.g., volume checks, freshness, pipeline success rates).
  • Comfortable using scripting or automation tools (e.g., Python, Bash) to support diagnostics and repetitive troubleshooting tasks.
  • Full ownership of identifying, investigating, and resolving data-related issues, including root cause analysis, query optimization, and data integrity checks, with minimal dependency on internal teams and occasional coordination with third-party providers if required.

Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos :

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos :

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

title: Financeiro
description:
Sobre a Simpay

A Simpay é uma Instituição de Pagamento focada em meios de pagamento digitais e PIX, em transição para operações cada vez mais diretas e reguladas. Buscamos alguém mão‑na‑massa, extremamente organizado e com rigor regulatório para cuidar do fluxo financeiro diário e das obrigações junto ao Banco Central.

Missão da vaga

Garantir envios diários e periódicos ao BCB com acurácia e pontualidade, manter reconciliações financeiras em dia e apoiar a contabilidade no cumprimento de CCS e integrações APIX, assegurando plena aderência às normas aplicáveis a Instituições de Pagamento.

Responsabilidades

  • Envios diários ao BCB (via APIX / RSFN, quando aplicável): posições de saldo em contas, fluxos/saldos enviados a participantes responsáveis/liquidantes, conferência de retornos, logs e reprocessamentos.
  • Reconciliação financeira e operacional: conciliação diária entre core de pagamentos, banco/liquidante, SPI / PIX e razão contábil, tratamento de pendências com trilha de auditoria.
  • Apoio à contabilidade em rotinas regulatórias: CCS – coleta de dados, validação e acompanhamento de envios/retornos; integrações APIX – suporte funcional às cargas/consultas, evidências dos envios e SLAs; preparação de dossiês e evidências para auditorias internas/externas e fiscalizações do BCB.
  • Calendário regulatório da IP: manter calendário de obrigações sempre atualizado, sinalizar riscos de prazo, antecipar bloqueios e propor planos de ação.
  • Indicadores e reporting: consolidar e reportar dashboards de acurácia/pontualidade dos envios, posição de saldos, ageing de reconciliações e status de CCS/APIX; elaborar relatórios gerenciais para Diretoria (Finanças/Compliance/Operações).

Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em Finanças/Backoffice/Controladoria em fintech, IP, banco, subadquirente ou similar.
  • Vivência com obrigações regulatórias do BCB para IP (CCS, integrações APIX, posições de saldo, evidências e trilha de auditoria).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado; noções de SQL para consultas simples em bases transacionais/BI.
  • Atenção a detalhes, raciocínio contábil e disciplina de processos; comunicação clara para interface com Contabilidade, Operações, Risco/PLD-FT e parceiros.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SPI/PIX, RSFN, participantes responsáveis/liquidantes.
  • Familiaridade com normas recentes do BCB aplicáveis a IPs.
  • Python para automação de rotinas/checagens e BigQuery/PostgreSQL.
  • Experiência com conciliação de carteiras e indicadores operacionais.

Competências comportamentais

  • Rigor (99,9%+ de acurácia), senso de propriedade e urgência.
  • Organização, gestão de prazos e visão de processo ponta-a-ponta.
  • Capacidade de documentar bem e sustentar evidências em auditorias.

KPIs da função

  • Pontualidade dos envios obrigatórios (100% dentro do prazo D+0/D+1).
  • Acurácia dos arquivos/posições (≥ 99,9%).
  • Reconciliações concluídas diariamente (100% D+1 sem pendências críticas).
  • Zero falhas não tratadas em APIX/CCS (0 incidentes críticos por mês).
  • SLA de resposta a áreas internas/BCB/auditores (≤ 1 dia útil).

Modelo de trabalho

Local: Remoto. Regime: PJ. Disponibilidade para janela operacional de envios/concilições no início do dia.

description:
Engineering & Computer Science Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development

About Innodata

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI‑powered solutions, partnering with 4 of the world’s top 5 technology companies and serving over 2,000 enterprise clients worldwide. With a workforce of 5,000+ subject matter experts and operations in 13 cities globally, Innodata is at the forefront of Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Large Language Model (LLM) development.

We combine deep domain expertise, advanced AI/ML capabilities, and high‑security infrastructure to build next‑generation AI systems that are more intelligent, context‑aware, and safe.

About the Role

We are seeking highly skilled Engineering & Computer Science Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with exceptional technical expertise, research ability, and content creation skills to join our AI/LLM training team.

In this role, you will design, curate, and review technical content that enhances AI’s understanding of engineering disciplines, computing systems, algorithms, software engineering principles, and applied technologies. Your expertise will directly shape how AI systems reason about, solve, and communicate engineering and computer science concepts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Development: Create high‑quality technical content, including:
    • Problem‑solving exercises and step‑by‑step solutions.
    • Theoretical and applied engineering summaries.
    • Software design patterns, coding best practices, and algorithm explanations.
    • Technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, and engineering principles.
  • Domain Coverage:
    • Engineering: Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Industrial, Systems, and Robotics.
    • Computer Science: Data Structures, Algorithms, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Cybersecurity, and AI/ML.
    • Software Engineering: Full‑stack development, DevOps, Cloud Computing, Databases, and Distributed Systems.
  • Model Evaluation & AI Training: Review AI‑generated responses to complex technical questions for accuracy and completeness, identify and correct conceptual gaps, computational errors, and ambiguous phrasing, and develop evaluation rubrics to improve reasoning and problem‑solving capabilities in AI.
  • Research & Technical Collaboration: Collaborate with engineers, computational linguists, and AI researchers to refine datasets and model performance; contribute insights on systems engineering principles, optimization, and software development lifecycles; support AI ethics and safety efforts to ensure responsible deployment of technical knowledge.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master’s or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field.
  • Strong foundation in:
    • Core Engineering Principles (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Systems, etc.)
    • Computer Science Concepts (Algorithms, Data Structures, Computational Complexity, etc.)
    • Software Development Practices (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD).
  • Demonstrated expertise in technical writing, curriculum development, or advanced R&D projects.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with ML, NLP, and LLMs (a plus).
  • Hands‑on experience with Python, C++, Java, or similar programming languages.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems, cloud computing, and cybersecurity fundamentals.
  • Strong ability to simplify complex concepts for varied audiences.

Why Join Innodata?

  • Influence AI reasoning in engineering and computing at a global scale.
  • Work with world‑class researchers, linguists, and technologists.
  • Contribute to cutting‑edge AI development shaping industries worldwide.
  • Remote‑first, flexible work arrangements and research‑driven culture.

Additional Information

Candidates must complete an English Language Assessment. This step is mandatory and non‑billable.

Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results. Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks. Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal – your role – outcome (metrics if possible). Atuando em projetos em mais de 14 países , tais como: Alemanha, Reino Unido, Japão, Suécia, Coréia do Sul, Moçambique, Guatemala, Argentina, Chile, Peru, entre outros.

Main responsibilities

O Product Owner é responsável por maximizar o valor do produto resultante do trabalho da equipe de desenvolvimento.

Essa função envolve uma colaboração estreita com o Gerente de Produto, os Proprietários de Negócio e as equipes de desenvolvimento para traduzir a visão e a estratégia de alto nível do produto em histórias de usuário e tarefas acionáveis. O Product Owner garante que a equipe entenda os requisitos do produto e trabalhe para entregar incrementos de alta qualidade que atendam às necessidades do negócio.

TPOs são necessários (em vez de POs) onde os produtos são altamente técnicos e exigem "Facilitadores de Tecnologia" frequentes para impulsionar os recursos de negócios.

  • Possuir e gerenciar as histórias de usuário de sua equipe designada dentro do backlog do produto, garantindo que estejam atualizadas, priorizadas e alinhadas com o roteiro do produto e a direção estratégica definidos pelo Gerente de Produto.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário claras, concisas e acionáveis com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Refina e prioriza continuamente o backlog com base no feedback das partes interessadas, no valor do negócio e nas mudanças nos requisitos.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Produto para entender a visão, a estratégia e os objetivos do produto.
  • Interagir com as equipes de Engenharia, Arquitetos e outras partes interessadas para coletar requisitos técnicos, feedback e validar histórias.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes interessadas e a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir o alinhamento.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e liderança às equipes de engenharia, garantindo que as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas com os requisitos do produto e os objetivos do negócio.
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos de Soluções de Tecnologia e Engenheiros de Integração para projetar e implementar soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar e aprovar projetos técnicos, garantindo que atendam aos padrões de qualidade e estejam alinhados com a visão do produto.
  • Participar das reuniões de planejamento do sprint para ajudar a equipe a entender os requisitos e priorizar as tarefas.
  • Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha um entendimento claro das histórias de usuário e dos critérios de aceitação.
  • Fornecer feedback e esclarecimentos oportunos à equipe de desenvolvimento durante os sprints.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para entregar incrementos de produto de alta qualidade que atendam aos requisitos definidos.
  • Realizar revisões e demonstrações regulares do trabalho concluído para coletar feedback e garantir o alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Garantir que os recursos entregues atendam aos critérios de aceitação e estejam prontos para lançamento.
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho do produto usando métricas e KPIs e tomar decisões baseadas em dados para aprimorar o produto.
  • Participar de retrospectivas e outras atividades de melhoria contínua para aprimorar o desempenho da equipe e a qualidade do produto.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor, melhores práticas e tecnologias emergentes para embasar as decisões sobre o produto.

  • Criar e manter documentação abrangente para histórias de usuários, recursos e requisitos do produto.

Ethos was built to make it faster and easier to get life insurance for the next million families. Our approach blends industry expertise, technology, and the human touch to find you the right policy to protect your loved ones.

We are scaling quickly and looking for passionate people to protect the next million families!

About the Role

Ethos is seeking a dynamic expert to take ownership of our regulatory product and forms filing. In this role, you’ll blend hands-on regulatory acumen with forward-looking product innovation to bring life insurance solutions to the market efficiently and compliantly. You’ll collaborate with carriers and cross-functional teams to navigate complex state regulations, ensuring new products and policy forms are designed, filed, and approved seamlessly. Your industry relationships and deep subject-matter expertise will be essential to influence regulators, shape product designs, and accelerate approvals.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Filing: Own and manage the Ethos portion of the filing process for policy forms and applications, ensuring speed, compliance, and quality.
  • Inform Product Development Strategy: Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, and carrier partners to refine product features and applications that balance innovation with regulatory standards.
  • Optimize Application Design: Provide expert guidance on bracketing, reflexive questions, and variability, enabling flexible yet compliant product offerings.
  • Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of regulatory changes and competitor filings, translating insights into tangible strategies and recommendations for product evolution.
  • Improve Processes Continuously: Innovate on filing processes by implementing best practices and technology solutions, bolstering efficiency and accuracy.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years in product form filings with strong understanding of state insurance department standards and requirements.
  • Broad knowledge of insurance products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to read and interpret laws and regulations related to product and endorsement forms and filings.
  • Proven ability to shape and refine insurance applications, other new business and disclosure forms, and related statements of variability based on internal, Carrier, and Regulator feedback.
  • Strong collaborative communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with carriers, legal, and compliance, UW, product development and product teams.
  • Highly self-sufficient and entrepreneurial, capable of driving both strategic initiatives, day-to-day filings, and forms creation and maintenance.
  • Experience in SERFF system a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, CPCU, FLMI, or AIRC a plus.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of product regulatory filings and guide the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Industry Influence: Build on your regulator relationships and shape the market through strategic advocacy.
  • Impactful Collaboration: Partner with a wide range of teams to harmonize regulatory needs with product vision.
  • High-Growth Environment: Join a rapidly evolving organization where your expertise can drive both immediate and long-term success.

If you’re ready to lead the charge in filing next-generation life insurance products—from concept to approval—we’d love to connect!

Também é legal você saber que...

A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros. Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão Sawabona. Esse, por sua vez, responde #Shikoba. Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim . E a resposta, Shikoba: Então eu sou bom e existo para você. Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e sentiu conexão com os nossos valores, venha para nossa tribo aqui é seu lugar!

description:
About

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid, disconnected software modules, our assistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural, empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience for every patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely and reliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empathetic experience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfully incorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at the frontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronous communication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture is service oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant services and applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention to safety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for other engineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring, automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for our products, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards and architectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled product experiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications, databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands‑on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining production applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Node.js (NestJS), and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (WebSockets, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significant impact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it through automated testing, CI/CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g., measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, CloudWatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure‑as‑code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (Retool, Salesforce Communities, Contentful, Next.js, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR / EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.

Benefits

  • Personal laptop.
  • Health / sport budget.
  • Fully remote.
  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.

  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.
