title: Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)
description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple:design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’sthe way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Join us and let’s build something extraordinary.

Também é legal você saber que…

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts! A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África. Quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona". Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba". Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim". E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você". Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro. description:
Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN

1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full timeSecurity Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches.

In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security

Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.

Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.

Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.

Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.

Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.

Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).

Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.

Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.

Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.

Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.

Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.

Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).

Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.

Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.

Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).

Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.

Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.

Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).

Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).

Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.

Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).

Experience with Secure Code Review.

Understanding of software supply chain.

Deep understanding of Linux internals.

Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.

Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).

Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company.

Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process.

Requests will be addressed confidentially.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please.

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Us

Stio® is an omni-channel mountain brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel, footwear and other accessories infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. We live and love mountain life, and as such see ourselves as caretakers of the resources that provide it. We are proud partners of Protect Our Winters and the Conservation Alliance among many other organizations. We have a strong preferred materials platform, use Bluesign® approved textiles wherever possible, audit our supply chains for best practices, and operate our workplaces responsibly.

We think that outside is the best side and that you can’t improve on nature. It’s good for mind, body and soul, and it’s our responsibility to help enable access for all people, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, background or ability. We strive for inclusion at Stio and in our local and national communities.

Your Role

The Stio Design Director is an ambitious and experienced leader responsible for shaping the creative vision and leading the design strategy for all product categories including outerwear, sportswear, footwear, logowear, equipment, and accessories. This role requires a proactive, engaged leader who can define, champion and shepherd the creative vision from initial concept to final product to the customer experience ensuring cohesive, authentic and impactful product experience across all channels. By using design thinking you will apply a deep understanding of the customer and lead a product creation cycle that delivers goods that are user-centered, solution oriented and suited for the totality of the active mountain lifestyle.

As a key member of the product leadership team, you will be connected to the long range product vision as well as the business drivers.   • Design Vision and Influence
    • Define and execute long-term design strategies across categories, leading the business with innovative trend research, color, print, and pattern development
    • Build and present concept, trend and seasonal GTM resources as needed to provide creative input and direction for all downstream GTM and customer experience activations such as photoshoots, styling, and overall visual presentation of the product
    • Lead Stio's seasonal color vision across all categories applying trend research and Stio color identity, directing visual evidence collection, and overseeing surface design execution including prints and yarn dye patterns to ensure a consistent, inspiring brand language
    • Maintain and evolve Stio's Design DNA, logo guidelines, construction standards, and color processes to ensure cohesive execution across categories
    • Act as the voice of the future unmet customer needs championing and advocating for the creative team's vision and necessary resources in high-level discussions
  • Product & Material Strategy
    • Lead the design creation process from concept to product approval, ensuring our mission of creating inspired, elevated, functional design is consistently executed
    • Lead innovation using the advanced development pipeline, creating concepts and validating construction challenges ahead of GTM commercialization to validate solutions prior to adoption into the seasonal line plan
    • Collaborate with Materials Managers to plan and direct all fabric and materials that align with seasonal merchandising and design intent
  • Team Leadership & Resourcing
    • Inspire, manage and mentor a team of designers, color/pattern specialists, and contractors, fostering innovation, collaboration, and executional excellence
    • Champion product design vision within the Stio strategy group, including senior leadership, to share and execute long range plan
    • Oversee design team workload and resource planning, manage external design partners, and be responsible for key areas of budget

Your Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in creative design or related field
  • 10+ years professional design experience in apparel/product development
  • 5+ years Creative/Design Director management experience
  • Management experience with 4+ direct reports
  • Proven experience bringing performance product to market across multiple categories
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Experience with 3D design (Vstitcher preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and PLM systems
  • Strong fashion illustration and technical drawing capabilities
  • Expertise in pattern development, mock-ups, and prototype creation
  • Advanced understanding of fabric performance, garment construction, and textiles
  • Commitment to our company mission, vision, and values
  • Ability to travel up to 20% (domestic and international) to support business initiatives

The Fine Print

  • Must be able to work in a sedentary position, move around the office, and occasionally move objects or boxes 15+ lbs
  • This role can be remotely located anywhere within the continental US.
  • Medical, Dental Vision plans
  • Company Paid Long Term Disability

  • 401k with Match
  • Flexible paid time off policies
  • Gear stipend, Company perks, and more

title: Zeiss med | banco de talentos para técnicos e engenheiros de campo | salvador!
description:
Estamos sempre analisando os currículos cadastrados e, havendo uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato para que você participe de nosso processo seletivo!Sobre a ZEISS:
- Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.
- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:
- Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.Sobre o nosso Banco de Talentos para Técnicos e Engenheiro de Campo:
Base de Trabalho - Salvador e região.Atividades:
- Instalação, treinamento aos usuários e manutenção (preventiva e corretiva) de equipamentos médicos.

• Alguém que só execute quando for cobrada
• Falta de atenção nos detalhes visuais (aparelho mal limpo, cenário desorganizado, iluminação ruim)
• Postagens e gravações feitas de qualquer jeito ou na correria
• Falta de iniciativa e comprometimento com entregas e metasPerfil ideal:
• Proatividade: não espera ordens para agir. Viu uma oportunidade de gravação? Vai lá e faz.

• Organização: cumpre prazos, ajuda a planejar o conteúdo com antecedência.
• Boa convivência: vai trabalhar em parceria com outra Social Media, então precisa somar.
• Mão na massa: queremos quem coloca a mão na câmera, na edição e na entrega.Importante:Você não vai fazer vídeos de campanha com câmera profissional – isso já temos com um filmmaker. Mas precisa saber gravar com o celular, editar vídeos simples e entregar conteúdo com constância e qualidade.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de ambiência- arquitetura
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Atividades:
Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

Power BI será um diferencial;

Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Possuir formação superior completa e/ou cursando.

Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.

Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).

Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.

title: Social media producer
description: *Vaga para Social Media* Estamos em busca de uma Social Media proativa, executora e criativa, com olhar apurado para captação de conteúdo e atenção aos detalhes, para atuar no dia a dia da nossa loja. ✅ O que você vai fazer: •	Gravar vídeos do dia a dia com o celular (stories, bastidores, conteúdos leves e espontâneos)•	Garantir que o cenário esteja sempre impecável (sem sujeiras, distrações ou aparelhos mal posicionados)•	Trabalhar em dupla com outra Social Media que já grava bem, ajudando a orientar e incentivar as gravações •	Criar ideias de conteúdos para stories e Reels de forma constante •	Ajudar na criação de campanhas (como Black Friday, Natal, etc.)•	Cumprir metas de conteúdo semanal, como gravações e postagens no feed •	Manter o planejamento e organização das demandas (seguindo prazos e cronograma)⚠️ O que a gente NÃ O quer: •	Alguém que só execute quando for cobrada •	Falta de atenção nos detalhes visuais (aparelho mal limpo, cenário desorganizado, iluminação ruim)•	Postagens e gravações feitas de qualquer jeito ou na correria •	Falta de iniciativa e comprometimento com entregas e metas   Perfil ideal: •	Proatividade: não espera ordens para agir. Viu uma oportunidade de gravação? Vai lá e faz. •	Visão estética: sabe o que é um cenário bonito, limpo, iluminado, com bom ângulo. •	Criatividade: traz ideias diferentes para conteúdos do dia a dia e campanhas pontuais. •	Organização: cumpre prazos, ajuda a planejar o conteúdo com antecedência. •	Boa convivência: vai trabalhar em parceria com outra Social Media, então precisa somar. •	Mão na massa: queremos quem coloca a mão na câmera, na edição e na entrega.   Importante:  Você não vai fazer vídeos de campanha com câmera profissional – isso já temos com um filmmaker. Mas precisa saber gravar com o celular, editar vídeos simples e entregar conteúdo com constância e qualidade.

title: Pessoa coordenadora de ambiência- arquitetura
description: ALLOS  é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.  A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a  Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls  , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.  Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.  E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.  Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS  Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;  Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.  Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.  Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.  Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz. Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. description: Estamos com uma oportunidade de  Coordenador/a Financeiro/a para atuar em uma de nossas obras na região de Salvador/BA. Este/a profissional orientará decisões financeiras estratégicas alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto, assegurando a eficiência dos recursos  , tendo estas principais atribuições:  Assegurar o correto funcionamento dos controles internos de contas a pagar e tesouraria, visando o cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras corporativas;  Elaborar demonstrações financeiras (DRE, BP, FC), modelos financeiros e análises de viabilidade;  Contribuir para gestão de caixa integrada do ambiente em que atua, qualificando e otimizando a programação financeira do projetos;  Atuar de forma proativa na redução de custos e gestão eficiente do caixa;  Dominar os procedimentos e conceitos contábeis, garantindo a correta alocação, os devidos registros de lançamentos, cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras e uso dos manuais de melhores práticas;  Apoiar a montagem dos negócios, através do conhecimento das diferentes estruturas societárias (consórcio, SPE, controlada direta e etc.);  Dominar os principais impostos incidentes no projeto, buscando a melhor gestão dos fiscal com vistas a manter a Segurança Empresarial;  Promover diretrizes orçamentárias, modelos de planejamento, acompanhamento e avaliação de desempenho do projeto, alinhado ao modelo de gestão definido pela Matriz;  Garantir assertividade no processo orçamentário, seja pela qualificação das equipes, pelo domínio das ferramentas e sistemas e através do conhecimento das características do ambiente de atuação do projeto, sempre qualificando as informações e propondo novos KPIs para acompanhamento;  Representar a companhia junto a terceiros (auditores, sócios, fornecedores, fisco e etc.), dominando os demonstrativos financeiros da operação.  Perfil Requerido:  Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou demais áreas correlatas;  Pós-Graduação ou MBA nas áreas de Finanças Corporativas, Controladoria, Administração de Negócios ou correlatos;  Experiência profissional comprovada em posições de liderança na área de Finanças;  Vivência anterior em empresas do ramo de Construção Civil Pesada ou Montagens Industriais será um diferencial;  Conhecimentos avançados dos principais softwares do Pacote Office;  Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região de Salvador/BA.  A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas: ✔ Transporte e Logística ✔ Energia ✔ Saneamento ✔ Engenharia Industrial ✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações  :  A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.  A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.  Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.  Você será a peça-chave para:  Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.  Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.  Construir relações de confiança que duram. title: Lavador de motos
description:
Descrição: 1. Realizar a lavagem externa e interna das motos de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.

10. Colaborar com a manutenção preventiva das motos, identificando possíveis problemas e reportando ao responsável.

title: VENDEDOR DE CONCRETO – SIMÕES FILHO, BA
description:
ATIVIDADES e/ou RESPONSABILIDADES

Buscar oportunidades de venda do concreto e do serviço de concretagem; Prospectar clientes ativamente, elaborar propostas comerciais, fechar contratos, cobranças e pedidos; Gerir a carteira de clientes; Visitar os clientes para fortalecer parcerias; Fazer a medição do volume de concreto necessário para cada obra; Acompanhar os serviços prestados e assessorar os clientes; Pós-venda com monitoramento da satisfação dos clientes; Manter contato direto com o responsável da usina.

EXIGÊNCIAS PROFISSIONAIS

Experiência prévia com vendas e conhecimento robusto geográfico da região; Experiência em vendas, atuação na área de concreto, construção civil; Experiência consolidada em vendas B2B, B2C; Boa comunicação, facilidade de negociação, flexibilidade; Facilidade com Pacote Office, Google Workspace e CRM de vendas; Formação técnica em edificações, ou superior em engenharia civil, logistica; Conhecimento técnico em tipos de concreto (convencional, bombeável, projetado, alta resistência, autoadensável, com fibras etc.), dosagens e aplicações; Conhecimento técnico em processos: Tempo de pega, transporte, logística de entrega, limites de distância e acesso; Saber sobre normas técnicas: ABNT NBR relacionadas a concreto e construção civil; Entender o canteiro de obras, etapas da concretagem, interferências climáticas, equipamentos de bombeamento.

CARACTERÍSTICAS PESSOAIS

Faixa etária: 18 a 50 anos; Residentes em SIMÕES FILHO. Pode residir em cidades próximas desde que consiga se deslocar facilmente; Necessário possuir veículo próprio e CNH na categoria do veículo; Foco em resultados; Organização; Agilidade; Boa comunicação; Trabalho em equipe.

HORÁRIOS, DIAS DA SEMANA e INTERVALOS

De segunda a sexta, 8 às 18h e sábado de 8 às 12h. 1h de almoço.

REMUNERAÇÃO

Salário compatível com o mercado + comissão por vendas diferenciada + margem.

Valor total entre 10.000 e 19.000.

BENEFÍCIOS

Plano de saúde Unimed Brasil; Plano odontológico Bradesco; Seguro de vida; Cartão alimentação; Ajuda de custo alimentação e combustível (o candidato precisa ter veículo próprio e será pago um valor pela locação do veículo); Gympass.

EMPLOYING BRANDING Estamos há mais de 30 anos no mercado, atuando com excelência na produção e fornecimento de concreto usinado. Com presença em 6 estados brasileiros e mais de 70 usinas em operação, somos referência no setor e continuamos em plena expansão. Nosso time já conta com mais de 500 colaboradores, e seguimos crescendo com base em valores sólidos, foco em qualidade e respeito pelas pessoas. Aqui, cada profissional é parte fundamental do que entregamos diariamente às maiores obras do país. Agora, buscamos alguém que queira construir com a gente. Se você tem conhecimento técnico, senso de responsabilidade e paixão por transformar rotinas em resultados, seu lugar pode ser aqui.

Auxiliar na higienização de banheiros, vidros, superfícies horizontais e verticais, como: mesa, bancada, parede, teto, cortinas, persianas e janelas varrendo e lavando a fim de manter as áreas limpas e organizadas;
Auxiliar na limpeza e no abastecimento das saboneteiras, papeleiras e produtos nos recipientes, repondo os materiais que estiverem acabando;
Abastecer e programar a Máquina de Lavar para com o objetivo manter limpos os panos e MOP´s;
Organizar as caixas com Kits de equipamentos de proteção individual, bem como auxiliar no preenchimento das fichas dos colaboradores do setor;
Organizar o estoque de Produtos de Higienização e Equipamentos, bem como, auxiliar na separação e distribuição do material para execução da higienização;
Organizar o carrinho funcional e/ou balaio de acordo com a padronização estabelecida pela Empresa;
Auxiliar na verificação das etiquetas de identificação e validade dos produtos conforme padrão estabelecido pela Empresa;
Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Promotor de Trade Marketing
description:
Descrição

A Goop , distribuidora da marca Takao  no Brasil, possui atualmente o maior portfólio de peças para motores à combustão disponíveis para o segmento de reposição, atendendo 95% da frota circulante atual.
Para fortalecer ainda mais nosso time de profissionais, buscamos nesse momento um Promotor Trade.
A vaga tem como objetivo fortalecer a presença da marca Takao no mercado, sendo o ponto de contato entre a empresa e os pontos de venda, com foco em promoção de produtos, ações promocionais e capacitação dos times de vendas. O profissional será responsável por cumprir o roteiro de visitas aos pontos de venda, divulgar lançamentos, garantir a execução de ações promocionais, e gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes e parceiros, com o objetivo de aumentar o sell-out e a presença da marca nas regiões atendidas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Cumprir o roteiro mensal de visitas aos pontos de venda, conforme planejamento. Apresentar a marca Takao aos clientes, destacando lançamentos, atualizações de catálogo, produtos em foco e campanhas ativas. Oferecer suporte aos processos internos, como acionamento de garantias, fornecimento de catálogos, informações logísticas e utilização do Takao Mais. Realizar coleta de dados de mercado, como pesquisa de preços e movimentações da concorrência, utilizando o sistema U.Move-Me. Comunicar de forma ágil situações emergenciais ao time Comercial e BKO, como rebaixas de preços ou ações concorrenciais. Divulgar campanhas promocionais, treinamentos e outras ações junto ao time de vendas e às lojas. Garantir a correta aplicação dos materiais de ponto de venda (MPDV), seguindo o Guide da marca. Promover ações regionais, como eventos, parcerias, palestras e treinamentos. Realizar reuniões com clientes visando identificar oportunidades para aumentar o sell-out. Prospectar novos negócios e parcerias nas regiões atendidas. Ministrar treinamentos com foco em venda intuitiva e oportunidades de venda casada. Acompanhar e garantir o pagamento de campanhas aprovadas pelo time Comercial e Trade. Atuar em parceria com os consultores comerciais, mantendo comunicação constante e alinhada. Reforçar a presença da marca em oficinas mecânicas, revertendo objeções e fortalecendo o relacionamento

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência:

Experiência prévia em campo com trade marketing, vendas externas, merchandising ou promotor de vendas. Vivência com atendimento a varejo e oficinas mecânicas será um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

Conhecimento de estratégias de exposição de produtos e positivação de PDV. Noções de marketing promocional e sell-out. Familiaridade com análise de mercado, concorrência e levantamento de preços. Conhecimento básico de logística e processos comerciais (ex: garantia, catálogo, prazos). Experiência com ferramentas de coleta de dados via sistema (ex: U.Move-me ou similares).

Habilidades Comportamentais:

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita. Perfil proativo, dinâmico e com capacidade de negociação. Organização, responsabilidade e foco em resultados. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.

title: AUXILIAR SERV GERAIS
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Executar limpeza concorrente nos setores conforme a rotina diária, de acordo com procedimento estabelecido, para adequada manutenção da organização e limpeza do contrato;
Executar a forração de leito e a limpeza terminal nos setores conforme a rotina e cronograma previsto, de acordo com padrão estabelecido, para adequada manutenção da organização e limpeza do contrato;
Executar a revisão dos setores, e quando necessário, realizar a reposição de dispense e insumos, garantindo a conservação do ambiente e contínuo abastecimento dos andares;
Retirar resíduos dos setores e quartos, conforme protocolo estabelecido, encaminhando-os para os expurgos temporários;
Registrar horários das limpezas concorrente/terminal no RAD (Relatório de Atividade Diária), inserindo horário de entrada e saída, informações complementares (quando necessário), para controle das atividades realizadas;
Zelar pela correta utilização do uniforme e EPIs, asseio pessoal, materiais e produtos, conforme padronização, higienização e sob orientação do superior hierárquico e normas de segurança, conforme orientação da empresa;
Organizar o DML (depósito de material limpo) e o material de limpeza, carinho funcional e/ou balaio, de acordo com a padronização estabelecida;
Entregar o material (carrinho funcional e balaio) e DML, organizados, conforme protocolo estabelecido no POP (procedimento operacional padrão) para o próximo colaborador pessoa que assumirá o plantão, visando à continuidade da qualidade do serviço prestado;
Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho, bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados.
Seguir os cronogramas preestabelecido, diário, semanal e mensal;
Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

ESCOLARIDADE MÍNIMO: Ensino Fundamental Incompleto. (Caso não haja documentação comprobatória de escolaridade, prevalecerá o preenchimento da ficha de inscrição comprovando a alfabetização).
DESEJÁVEL: Ensino Fundamental Completo.
EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA MÍNIMO: Não aplicável.
DESEJÁVEL: 06 meses (Caso não haja documentação comprobatória, prevalecerá a experiência em carteira profissional).
HABILITAÇÃO/CERTIFICAÇÕES Não aplicável

9. Some end-of-day processing/monitoring needed

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Júnior (Vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência)
description:
Sobre o BS2

Somos um banco 100% digital e focado em empresas, com atendimento humanizado e soluções sob medida para cada cliente - afinal, nenhum negócio é igual ao outro. Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Por aqui, nossos colaboradores (os bessers) podem contar com um ambiente que impulsiona o crescimento da carreira e traz a oportunidade de lidar com os desafios do mercado financeiro com quem mais entende do assunto.


Sobre a área:

Atuação em squad responsável pela evolução tecnológica e modernização das aplicações de Internet Banking PJ, com foco em eficiência, simplicidade e entrega de valor.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções back-end em .NET Core (versão 7.5 ou superior) e .NET Framework.
  • Apoiar a modernização de sistemas legados, utilizando templates e frameworks atualizados.
  • Colaborar com o time para garantir entregas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e propor ideias para melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento básico em .NET Core (a partir da versão 7.5) e .NET Framework.
  • Fundamentos de SQL Server.
  • Noções de orientação a objetos, design patterns, Docker e fundamentos de desenvolvimento back-end.
  • Estar cursando ou ter concluído graduação em áreas de tecnologia (último semestre é aceito).
  • Perfil propositivo, com iniciativa para aprender, sugerir melhorias e protagonizar o próprio desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais:

  • Interesse em atuar em ambiente de diversidade e inclusão.
  • Vontade de crescer e evoluir tecnicamente.
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de modernização tecnológica.


Modelo de Trabalho:

Remoto, com preferência para candidatos de São Paulo ou Belo Horizonte.


Nossos benefícios:

️ Vale refeição no valor de R$1.050,21 ao mês;

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Agile Scrum Master - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Agile Scrum Master will be instrumental in driving team performance and organizational agility by facilitating Scrum methodologies and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role requires strategic facilitation of development processes to ensure efficient, high-quality software delivery aligned with business objectives.


Key Responsibilities:


-Facilitating Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

-Coaching team members on Agile principles and Scrum practices to enhance team performance.

-Identifying and removing impediments that affect team productivity and sprint goals.

-Collaborating with Product Owners to ensure backlog refinement and prioritization.

-Tracking and communicating team progress, metrics, and potential risks to stakeholders.

-Promoting a culture of continuous improvement, transparency, and self-organization.


Requirements:


-Experience: 3+ years as a Scrum Master or in similar Agile roles

-Tools: Experience with Agile project management tools

-Leadership Skills: Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution capabilities

-Influence: Ability to guide teams without direct authority

-Technical Understanding: Comprehensive knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles

-Language: Advanced level of English



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor SAP MM Senior
description:
Requisitos:

• Sólida experiência no módulo MM;

• Conhecimento básico no módulo SD;

• Experiência em Processos de Suprimentos e Logística;

• Consultor deverá ser proativo, ter habilidades de comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;

• Se identificar com os valores de confiança, excelência, comprometimento, amizade, humildade e respeito;

• Ser curioso e se interessar pelo negócio, seus processos, objetivos e problemas (e não apenas por sistemas);

• Ser questionador. Perguntar o suficiente para ter um bom entendimento do que está sendo discutido ou proposto;

• Ter pensamento crítico e questionar soluções e problemas na busca da melhor opção;

• Ter ownership e liderança com relação às suas responsabilidades (cumprir prazos e ter independência na busca de soluções).


Responsabilidades:

• Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, suporte, rollout;

• Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

• Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

• Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

• Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

• Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

• Ser flexível e ter o discernimento para entender quando deve ou não abrir exceções;

• Auxiliar no detalhamento de atividades requeridas;

• Comunicar ativamente as ocorrências do projeto;

• Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução;

• Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto;

• Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

• Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes;

• Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.
